text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'm guessing you've come to<n>volunteer yourself.
You must be<n>willing to become my test subject, as<n>a
gift for my birthday.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I thought you'd say that. But I've got<n>a normal
present for you... so enough<n>of that.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Not only can you see<n>invisible people, it
seems you can<n>predict the future now too.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, when your occipital lobe<n>processes visual
information, your<n>limbic system becomes active, as
if<n>visualizing something.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That region may be more developed<n>in you
compared to other subjects.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Are you trying to say... that the world I<n>see is...
some kind of hallucination?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No! You can perceive phenomena that<n>science is
unable to prove the<n>existence of. You possess a
rare<n>specimen of a brain!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Have you grown curious to learn<n>more about your
mind?! We can start<n>with a simple brain wave scan!
Just<n>let me fetch some electrodes and a<n>respirator!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...No, thanks. Also, I forgot to tell you<n>something.
